text: The `model` probe mode now sets `HOOK = on_mark` and `ALSEM_RETAINED_CENSUS=1` for ALL of q6, not just the new `q6_retained_census`. `on_mark` calls `reset_peak()`, so every engine mark inside the old Q6 `phase()` closures resets PEAK in the middle of the phase. evidence: | CR1 | important | fixed | a32d0519 | `tools/census-probe/src/main.rs:1497-1502` (before): `model` set `ALSEM_RETAINED_CENSUS=1` and `HOOK = on_mark` for all of q6; `on_mark` (`:275-286`) calls `reset_peak()`, so every engine mark reset PEAK inside q6's `phase()` closures (`:1017-1030`), and the census walks ran inside q6's timed phases. Fix: the census moves to its own mode `census-probe retained <ws>`; `model` sets neither and no longer calls `q6_retained_census`. Fix: `PhaseState` keeps `ended_max` = max over every ended phase; new `pt::end_phase` is called in `load_workspace_side` after the side's model is dropped, so side 2's build is in no phase; `peak.post_attach_mb` = max over all phases. Spec §4.1.4 bullet and CHANGELOG updated | unit `perf_trace::tests::phase_peak_is_the_max_over_every_phase` (first phase's max hand-stated as 2^50). Break: `PhaseState::end` `self.ended_max = self.ended_max.max(s.finish())` -> `self.ended_max = s.finish()`. Fail: `perf_trace.rs:1110 left: Some(Some(9826304)) right: Some(Some(1125899906842624))`. text: `mark_phase_start` is not atomic: it calls finish_phase (lock, take, unlock), starts a sampler, then locks again to store it. Two overlapping callers each start a sampler. The second store overwrites the first, which is never stopped or joined, so a thread is orphaned and its maximum is lost.
evidence: | CR5 | minor | fixed | a32d0519 | `perf_trace.rs:657-667` (before): lock/take/unlock, `PhaseSampler::start()` unlocked, then a second lock to store, so two racing callers could overwrite a running sampler (never stopped). Fix: all phase state is one `Mutex<PhaseState>`; `start` ends the old sampler and stores the new one under the same lock | unit `perf_trace::tests::racing_phase_starts_orphan_no_sampler` (8 threads x 25 starts behind a barrier; every started sampler's stop flag must be set after finish). Break: `start_phase` rewritten to the old shape (end under one lock, start unlocked, store under a second lock). Fail, 3 runs of 3: `perf_trace.rs:1154 samplers never stopped left: 8 / 9 / 7 right: 0`. Revert: green |
